properties.title: Request Volume (5min bins)
properties.query:
SOURCE '${LOG_GROUP_NAME}' | filter @message like /METRIC/ and @message like /agent_e2e_latency_ms/
| stats count() as request_count by bin(5m)

properties.title: Error Rate (errors / total requests per 5min)
properties.query:
SOURCE '${LOG_GROUP_NAME}' | filter @message like /METRIC/
| fields @message like /agent_error/ as is_error, @message like /agent_e2e_latency_ms/ as is_request
| stats sum(is_error) as errors, sum(is_request) as total by bin(5m)
| display errors / total * 100 as error_rate_pct

properties.title: E2E Latency Percentiles (p50, p95, p99)
properties.query:
SOURCE '${LOG_GROUP_NAME}' | filter @message like /METRIC/ and @message like /agent_e2e_latency_ms/
| parse @message '"value":*,' as latency
| stats percentile(latency, 50) as p50, percentile(latency, 95) as p95, percentile(latency, 99) as p99 by bin(5m)

properties.title: Retries Distribution
properties.query:
SOURCE '${LOG_GROUP_NAME}' | filter @message like /METRIC/ and @message like /agent_retries/
| parse @message '"value":*,' as retries
| stats count() as frequency by retries
| sort retries asc
